title: Chipping Norton - Oxford and Wellington Crews - WW2
memorial_details:
A rectangular metal Plaque mounted on the wall of a house. The dedication is written in raised white lettering on a blue background, the names are listed in two columns.

The inscription mentions 'IN MEMORY OF THE AIRCREWS', indicating a community connection, likely local people affected or those who erected the memorial.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF THE AIRCREWS WHO DIED HERE/ & NEARBY AFTER A NIGHT FLYING ACCIDENT/ 21ST AUGUST 1942/ (8 Names)/ PER ARDUA AD ASTRA
